scoringCalibration: One hair point is earned because the main fiber groom now has separate large and medium textured clump layers that establish a readable side part and continuous crown coverage. Ear-side density, rear hem design, clump breakup and anisotropic response remain below modern hero-character quality.
visualFindings: The side part and crown mass remain readable across front and three-quarter views instead of dissolving into isolated lines.
Large cards provide silhouette coverage while the offset medium layer breaks up broad sheet-like bands.
Ear-region cards that crossed the body were removed and the rear cards terminate near a controlled short-hair hem.
rejectedExperiments: The first v41 pass inherited full fiber tails and was rejected for wet string-like rear and ear silhouettes.
Centerline-only clearance was rejected after exact BVH checks found 121 large-card and 24 medium-card body intersections.
Uniform layer offsets were rejected because 29 medium faces still crossed the large layer; those faces are now removed during the build.
blockingFailures: The primary groom still needs authored crown breakup, cleaner ear-side grouping, a deliberate rear hem and better large-to-medium clump rhythm.
Hair material response still lacks a calibrated melanin-like color model, dual-lobe anisotropic highlights and strand-scale roughness variation.
The body needs expression-compatible lip loops and a deformable mouth opening before teeth and tongue can be exposed during speech.
Integrated upper and lower eyelid thickness and expression-compatible canthus topology remain below review quality.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the standard pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
